claim: For the fixed valuation vector and smooth Newton subdivision \(\Gamma\) of Cueto--Markwig Example 1.2, let the fifteen nonzero initial coefficient signs \(s_{ij}\in\{\pm1\}\) vary, modulo simultaneous global sign, so there are exactly \(2^{14}=16384\) projective sign orthants. Define \(A=[s_{00}s_{22}>0]\), \(B=[s_{21}s_{31}s_{30}s_{22}<0]\), and \(C=[s_{12}s_{13}s_{22}s_{03}<0]\). If \(k=A+B+C\), then the Viro patchwork of the real quartic near the tropical limit has exactly \(k+1\) connected components, while the Cueto--Markwig lift rules give respectively \(4,8,16,28\) real bitangents for \(k=0,1,2,3\). Each of the eight truth patterns of \(A,B,C\) occurs in exactly \(2048\) projective sign orthants. Consequently the exact orthant census is \(2048\) one-oval quartics with \(4\) real bitangents, \(6144\) quartics with two non-nested ovals and \(8\) real bitangents, \(6144\) three-oval quartics with \(16\) real bitangents, and \(2048\) four-oval quartics with \(28\) real bitangents. In particular, within this fixed tropical chamber, the \(4\)-real-bitangent case never has empty real locus or two nested ovals.
integrity: The topological census is an exhaustive finite computation over all projective sign orthants using an exact reconstruction of the unimodular lower subdivision; the bitangent counts are derived from the published necessary-and-sufficient sign rules and four-lifts theorem.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the fixed valuation vector and smooth Newton subdivision of Cueto--Markwig Example 1.2.
The topology is the Viro-patchworked topology near the tropical limit; arbitrary changes of coefficient valuations are outside the claim.
A later or unindexed computation may have exhaustively enumerated the same sign orthants under different terminology.
title: Three lift characters classify all \(2^{14}\) sign orthants of the Cueto--Markwig quartic
